contract_groups.id: transactional local builder and shared transform
contract_groups.comparison: Builder member admits centre/nonnegative size/rotation then all eight computed corners before geometry, records FIRST error for final boundary, and uses same corner permutation for mesh and ground support. Collider copied from same centre,size and extracted YXZ angles; Decoration intentionally omits collider while retaining visible geometry and ground contact as authored. Final finish rejects prior error, computes vertex bounds, derives one horizontal origin, subtracts that same origin from vertices/collider centres/support points/clearance bounds before checked final product. Empty sentinels cannot admit bounds; computed position/clearance error returns no successful owned product. Vertex normal/UV validity and native index/workload capacity are not established merely by checked positional bounds. P16 scoped Builder excludes finish242+ and collider218+, so its full finished-product guarantee is not inferred from PR body.

Finish boards uses SAME pitch/count for positions and member width minus explicit reveal; replacement changes full board material, handled face replaces original quad with eight-sided ring+inner fan, not duplicate skin. Fixed perimeter/inner arrays both length8 and loops use that same cardinality, paired positions/UV interpolate same face edges. Signed normal flips preserve orientation; zero/degenerate triangle normalize still requires actual authored member geometry policy, no new ordinary invalid member inferred. Real .0015 depression is visible wear, not an extra physical collision dent; original finish fixtures deliberately require identical colliders, bounds, supports and clearances across finishes. P16 only declarations1–29/face54–88, not boards30–52/worn_face89+ or fixtures.

contract_groups.id: placement frame and independently authored usability
contract_groups.comparison: ArchitecturalFurniturePose rotates local collider centre then translates to Architectural, sums yaw and re-admits computed coordinates/radians before returning; same local source preserved. Source IDs intentionally local to recipe and must be scoped by runtime instance, not globalunique by this conversion. InteriorFurnitureSpec sizes/required_faces/working depth are authored placement envelopes independently of mesh as docs1 states; access_bounds computes each requested side from same size/depth and checks SpatialBounds. Do not force every access volume equal physical mesh, or derive requested usability from arbitrary vertices. Factory kind/variant and placement_role consistent for exact five outdoor kinds versus45 interior.

FurnitureRecipe documents visible-vertex enclosure and grounded supported whole object, but derives Clone and exposes meshes, colliders, bounds, supports, clearances independently. A caller can clone a successful small cached recipe, move an existing visible vertex beyond saved bounds, and retain old valid bound/support/collider fields. All individual positions may remain finite; relationship breaks without invalid scalar. This is F057 API-only, not a flaw in normal immutable OnceLock product. Preserve authored independent usability envelopes and decorative visible-vs-collision differences; strengthen ownership of the compiled whole product/read-only access or a coherent rebuild operation.
